name: ST NUCLEO-C031C6 (Nucleo-64)
description: Cheapest way into STM32C0: a 48 MHz Cortex-M0+ (32 KB flash) on a Nucleo-64 with ST-LINK/V2-1, Arduino Uno V3 headers and full ST morpho access.
notes: ST-LINK/V2-1 gives drag-and-drop flashing, a virtual COM port and SWD debug; no separate programmer needed.
STM32C031 has no USB peripheral, so the only USB port is the ST-LINK one. 32 KB flash / 12 KB RAM is fine for simple control, tight for RTOS plus protocol stacks.
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
